name: Motorway Cops: Catching America's Speeders
summary: Follow New Jersey police as they tackle drunk, drugged, and reckless driving. With the highest traffic-related deaths in 15 years, New Jersey has a lot at stake. We gain unique access to two police departments, where cameras reveal the daily challenges faced by officers striving to maintain safety on the 39,000 miles of highway. From dashcam footage showing shocking incidents nationwide to the humorous moments on the job, witness the chaotic reality of policing as in Clifton, New Jersey.

name: Lost Dog, Found Dog with Clare Balding
summary: Clare Balding returns to celebrate the unbreakable bond we have with our dogs, sharing emotional stories of missing dogs, their dramatic rescues and joyful reunions with their owners.

name: The Air Fryer Diet: Lose Weight Fast
summary: This series is packed full of ingenious ways to feel healthier, save cash and smash your way into the New Year, with your trusted air fryer by your side. Presented by Cherry Healey, we compare and contrast all your favourite meals and treats with an air fryer version. Nutritionist Jenny Tschiesche counts the calories, while air fryer chef Dan Edwards recommends fast and furious food that also works wonders for the waistline.

name: Luminare Christmas!
summary: LUMINARE CHRISTMAS! creates a magical atmosphere that's perfect for all ages, fueled by sonically lush vocal and instrumental musical performances. Their iconic sound can be described as a combination of Mannheim Steamroller's classic holiday vibes, with the high-energy rock of Trans-Siberian Orchestra, and the stirring cinematic atmosphere of Hans Zimmer. The end result is a musical fusion for the senses that is sure to captivate audiences.

name: Celebrity Bear Hunt
summary: A Spice Girl, a ballroom star, a Wimbledon champ and more walk into a jungle — and only one can emerge victorious. Who will be the last celebrity standing?

name: The Appearance of the Murderer
summary: Lin Chuan, haunted by a classmate's mysterious death, spends ten years searching for the truth. Meanwhile, Shen Xia and her brother Shen Dong are drawn into a criminal underworld after a family tragedy. As their paths collide, a tense showdown between justice and crime unfolds, blending love, hate, and revenge in a captivating story.

name: Always My General
summary: From a young age, Zhou Chu, the commander of the Xuanjia Army, had disguised herself as a man. Upon her triumphant return to Beizhao, she was ambushed, only to discover that the culprit was none other than her sworn brother, Deputy General Xu Hanzhi. Rescued by her former battlefield rival, Shang Kefeng, Zhou Chu reclaimed her female identity and assumed the alias Xue Shisan. She infiltrated Dengying Tower to seek revenge on Xu Hanzhi, who resided there. She maneuvered between the two men in her quest for truth, feigning submission while treading a perilous path at every turn.

name: Chancers
summary:
Join Belfast comedians Shane Todd and Ciarán Bartlett for a new sketch show showcasing the best of Northern Ireland's new comic talent.

From cringe-worthy encounters to moments of pure slapstick, the show will feature sketches on the creation of the horse on day six of the universe; the inevitable outbreak of a Mafia war at the hands of a dodgy go-between; bad life and business coaching, and sketches depicting scenes of comedic modern ‘torture'.

Expect cinematic parodies, surprising twists, and the kind of humour that only Northern Ireland's comedy scene can deliver.

name: Комьюнити
summary: Atmospheric show by Rasul Chabdarov and Pavel Dedishchev. You will see stand-up comedians, cool guests, friendly communication and live music.

name: Stifel Snow Show
summary: The Stifel Snow Show brings fans unparalleled access to every sport on the FIS World Cup circuit, including alpine skiing, snowboarding, freeskiing, cross country and more. Hosted by NBC Sports' Ahmed Fareed and Cara Banks, the show blends in-depth analysis, recaps of the week's action and interviews with athletes and experts.

name: History's Most Shocking
summary: History is made in moments where life hangs in the balance; when split-second decisions mean the difference between disaster and survival; when the safe, orderly world disintegrates into chaos. These are the moments that populate the pantheon of History's Most Shocking. This show takes viewers frame-by-frame into the most significant mind-blowing events ever caught on camera. From chilling accidents to natural disasters to extreme sports fails to harrowing animal attacks, History's Most Shocking is a deep dive into the extreme, uncovering the truth behind what happened. It not only captivates the eye; it also provides key takeaways into what went wrong, and what needs to be avoided in the future. With compelling first-person narratives from the people who lived through these seminal moments and expert analysis identifying the miscalculations and misjudgments that caused them, History's Most Shocking won't just keep you on edge of your seat…. It will teach you the history lessons you were never taught in school.

previousepisode.name: The Hindenburg Disaster, Pilot's Ejection Fail, When Trees Attack & Stuck in a Cave

name: Bâtards
summary: Thousands of abandoned children, doomed to die on the outskirts of cities - Each year, 20 of them find themselves in the arena of a reality TV show. Determined not to fall back into poverty, they face a fierce competition to win the jackpot and be adopted by a celebrity couple. But this time around, the rules are changing.

name: Festivals
summary: Provides an immersive experience of Nepal's rich cultural history and traditions. The series showcases Nepal's ancient rituals that celebrate the relationship between brother and sister, elders, animals and honouring deceased family members.

name: Deal or No Deal Island After Show
summary: "Boston" Rob Mariano sits down with eliminated players to break down gameplay, talk drama on the island and share never-before-seen footage from the latest episode of Deal or No Deal Island.

previousepisode.name: Deal or No Deal Island S2 E12

name: Inspector Willoughby
summary: A cartoon character created by Walter Lantz and named after the Hollywood avenue which runs alongside the building where Lantz's office was located at 861 Seward Street.

previousepisode.name: The Case of the Elephant's Trunk

name: Ozark Law
summary: For nine months of the year, the peaceful towns around central Missouri's Lake of the Ozarks are home to just a few thousand residents. However, when summer arrives, millions of tourists flock to the area, seeking fun on the water and vibrant nightlife in the bars. This surge transforms the serene environment into a bustling hub, putting extra pressure on local law enforcement. In this new 10-episode series, viewers join the Lake Ozark Police Department and Osage Beach Police Department on their daily patrols, witnessing firsthand the challenges they face in maintaining order and ensuring safety in this lively midwestern destination.

name: Messi and the Giants
summary: The action-adventure series follows Leo, an ordinary 12-year-old boy with an extraordinary talent and a huge problem. The once-thriving world of Iko is in tatters at the mercy of the Giants who rule the 10 realms. Only one hero can save them … and he's the size of a flea. Young Leo is plucked from another world to lead the fight against the tyrannical villains who have kept the 10 realms under their control.

name: Kugel
summary: Kugel, the captivating prequel to Shtisel, takes viewers on an emotional journey into the lives of Nuchem and Libbi, father and daughter, set in Antwerp's Orthodox Jewish community. Nuchem, played brilliantly by Sasson Gabay, is a witty jewelry dealer whose charm lies as much in his storytelling as in his trade. His daughter, Libbi, portrayed by Hadas Yaron, is a seminar teacher yearning to make her mark in the Orthodox literary world.

name: Vacationland
summary:
Vacationland follows top LAPD detective Grace Chen after she resigns from her job in disgust. She retires to the quirky village of Serenity, Maine, determined to put it all behind her. When Serenity's Sheriff is murdered, however, Grace finds herself dragged back into crime fighting by Joey, a local veterinarian and amateur sleuth determined to protect the town she loves.

Between Grace's big-city detective skills and Joey's understanding of Maine, they turn out to be a surprisingly effective team … and a very unlikely pair of friends.

name: La sombra de la tierra
summary: In 1896, Villaveza del Agua is an impoverished town where two rival widows, Garibalda and Atilana, engage in a power struggle. This battle drags their children into a cursed inheritance, and neither can see the impact until it's too late.

name: Кто нас нарисовал?
summary: A series of documentaries about the history of Russian animation, dedicated to the 85th anniversary of the Soyuzmultfilm studio. Each of the 15 films tells about the main stages of the development of animation art in our country, about the unique achievements of Russian animation and its influence on world art. Also, an important part of the film will be a description of the historical events against which animated films of different eras were created.

name: A Landscape of Love
summary: Qin Hao, facing a career crisis, reunites with Lu Shiming, a former junior who left a high-paying job to return home and start a business. Together, they heal, find love, and work to revitalize the countryside.

name: Nine Puzzles
summary: After discovering the body of her murdered uncle, Yoon Ena becomes a profiler to uncover the truth behind what happened that night. A decade later, Detective Hansaem still suspects Ena was responsible, and when a series of murders begins to occur, each linked to a corresponding puzzle piece, Hansaem will follow his instincts to track down the killer.

name: Conspirators
summary: Conspirators follows a group of friends seven years after high school working for a local politician, Hudson, running for mayor. After running into an old friend, "The Gang" must uncover the truth about his shooting and disappearance, uncovering the truth about Hudson in the process. These secrets may lead to Hudson dropping out of the race, and more than likely to his arrest; however, with only partial information on the flash drive, the group doesn't know what to believe. They have to find out the truth and decide whether to help Hudson or take him down with all of his government counterparts in the biggest hack they've ever pulled.

name: RTÉ News Special
summary: Special broadcasts from the RTÉ News team.

name: Fáilte
summary: On New Year's Even Dháithí Ó Sé and Doireann Ní Ghlacáin will bring their now traditional New Year's gathering to the Cultúrlann on the Falls Road where the host a party full of music and song to bring in the New Year.

name: Carols in the Domain
summary: Carols in the Domain is an iconic, annual free Christmas concert in Sydney, Australia, bringing together top Australian performers for a festive musical spectacular, broadcast live for millions to enjoy, celebrating community and the holiday spirit under the stars

previousepisode.name: A Night for Remembrance and Unity

name: The Fall of the House of Murdaugh
summary: This 6-part series, hosted by Martha MacCallum, covers the twists in the Alex Murdaugh double homicide case with exclusive interviews, prison audio, and never-before-seen family video & photographs.

name: Vargasommar
summary: Haparanda police officer Hannah Wester makes a macabre discovery when a dead wolf is found with human remains in its stomach. The find soon turns out to be the first in a series of brutal events that shake the small border town to its core.

name: Brady vs Belichick: The Verdict
summary: Host Christopher "Mad Dog" Russo gets to the bottom of one of the hottest debates in sports, who deserved more credit for the New England Patriots success: Bill Belichick or Tom Brady?

name: Kibic
summary: Two warring football clubs take their rivalry off the pitch and into the world of crime and violence. Teenager Kuba must do whatever it takes to survive.

name: Seoul Check-in
summary: Kim Tae Ho returns with a new show featuring Lee Hyo Ri. Her easy-going and cool personality can be fully seen as she makes a visit to Seoul every week from Jeju Island. She visits the hottest places in Seoul and meets up with her friends. Join Hyo Ri as she makes her Seoul Check-in!

name: Edificio Corona
summary: If before COVID-19 no neighbors knew each other, it will be under the current circumstances that causes the confinement, that they will begin to relate in the midst of daily conflicts product of coexistence.

previousepisode.name: Дебош Джигана. Слив Пескова. Путин тупит. Дудь со звездочкой. Кукушкин «Я война». Ужасный Киселев

name: In the Room
summary: At Kamikei Gakuen, Tenma Ryo serves as a counselor, listening to students, teachers, and parents seeking help with their issues. Despite their reluctance and attempts to conceal their concerns, Ryo's unique approach gently and sometimes boldly exposes their underlying troubles, mending their emotional wounds. While perceived as a highly-skilled psychiatrist by his peers, Ryo grapples with his own inner demons. His choice of profession and the significance of mending hearts raise questions about his motivations and past.

name: Sir Alex
summary:
Sir Alex chronicles the incredible life and career of Sir Alex Ferguson, the most decorated football manager in British history.

First-hand accounts from a host of former players and adversaries, including Ole Gunnar Solskjaer, Andy Cole, Gordon Strachan and Sir Kenny Dalglish, reveal what it was like to play for Sir Alex's all-conquering Manchester United and Aberdeen teams en route to their famous European triumphs in 1983 and 1999.

name: Boomerang Kids
summary: Rob returns home, much to his mother's disappointment. It doesn't take long till he and his friends are caught up in pyramid scheme.

name: Harpoon Hunters
summary: Each summer on Cape Cod, multi-generational fishing families race against the clock - and each other - to catch highly valuable Atlantic bluefin tuna using only 10-foot electrified spears. Time is of the essence as harpoon boats only have four weeks to catch as many fish as they can before the overall limit is met. With fish worth as much as $10K each, stakes are high for these expert fishermen to make ends meet for their families and beat the competition to take home these prize fish.

name: Дорога домой
summary: The daring provincial Lena Zhuravleva came to Moscow for the good life. But the capital did not conquer her at first – all her achievements and plans collapsed in one moment. Lena returns home, and in order not to become a laughing stock in her hometown, she puts on a show: she arrives in chic outfits and tells everyone that she works on television. Having learned that her ex-boyfriend Misha is going to get married, Lena makes a bet that she will easily quarrel him with his bride. The task turns out to be difficult, but the ambitious Lena cannot afford to lose here either. Her plan leads to a real crime.

name: Рок-н-ролл под Кремлём
summary:
Based on the novel by Daniil Koretsky.
A young graduate of the FSB Academy, Yuri Yevseyev, gets his hands on a tape recording of a recruiting conversation between a CIA agent and a graduate of the flight school. Analysis shows that the recording is already 30 years old. Young lieutenant Yevseyev discovers a listening device and tries to track down the spy. But the investigation only seems hopeless...

name: Brit Cops Down Under
summary:
Brit Cops Down Under is a documentary following a group of seven UK police officers as they make the momentous decision to uproot their lives and move to the other side of the world to become Western Australian Cops.

Western Australia is the largest, most remote and sparsely populated police district in the world. On arrival, the new recruits undergo three months of training, including taser and firearms, and they must pass all units before starting a three-month probation period on the beat. But it's not just the work that's tough. They are starting their lives all over again, some with young children and partners, leaving family and friends behind.

name: The Legend of Outback Gold
summary:
The Legend of Outback Gold is a documentary adventure series following amateur treasure hunters and lifelong friends, Jeff Harris and Brendan Elliot who, at 10 years old, learned at school about a huge deposit of gold and made a pact to find it.

The story goes that prospector, Harold Lasseter, claimed to have seen the riches in remote Outback Australia, but when he returned in 1930 to re-discover the gold, he perished in the outback. He left behind a diary filled with clues that the treasure hunters will follow across hostile land and in extreme temperatures. Now, in a last-ditch attempt to find the legendary gold, they'll be joined by experts, including a geologist and a historian. Jeff and Brendan are determined to find the infamous gold deposit that will change their lives forever, and potentially start a new gold rush.

name: Vikkatakavi
summary: In the 1970s, the people of Amaragiri are devastated by a plague that causes memory loss. A detective, Rama Krishna, arrives to investigate the case. Will he find the cause or fall prey to the curse?

name: To Catch a Smuggler: Mediterranean
summary: Join the Spanish coastguard, a team of elite professionals, who risk their lives daily to protect the 8,000 kilometres of Spanish coastline.

name: La revancha
summary: After some business between Aristides Ruiz and Rodrigo Arciniegas, which ends in the death of Aristides, his two daughters: Mariana and Isabela are separated and take completely different paths. On the one hand, Mariana, who changes her name to Soledad, is raised in humility and poverty, together with an adoptive mother and her grandmother, making her a hard-working and simple girl, but on the other hand, her sister Isabela is raised in luxury and comforts, and that is why it is arrogant and capricious. However, fate will make these two sisters meet again but in a not very favorable way, since both are in love with the same man, Alejandro Arciniegas, son of the murderer of their father.

name: Locura de Amor
summary: A psycologist is hired as a teacher in a boarding school for rich girls. One of the students named Natalia Sandoval tries to seduce him on his first week.

name: Luna, la heredera
summary: Luna lives with her mother in a small village at the Caribbean beach. This beautiful piece of land is targeted by Esteban Lombardo, a wealthy businessman who wishes to build a hotel resort there. Victoria Mendoza, Luna's mother refuses to sell her property and gets help from Mauricio García, a young lawyer, whose sole purpose is to bankrupt Lombardo. One day Luna and Mauricio meet at the beach and the kiss they share changes their destiny. Unfortunately Victoria dies tragically during a struggle with a henchman, sent there to force her to sell the land. Now Luna becomes the heiress to the land and the local police suspects her in the murder of her own mother. She leaves her home and arrives in the city, where she stays with her aunt Beatriz and her family. Her cousin Margarita works in a modeling agency and gets Luna a job as seamstress. But her life changes drastically when the fashion designer Danny sees Luna as his new model and inspiration. One evening after her makeover Luna attends a soiree at the club where she bumps into Mauricio and produces a very serious impression on him. Later that night she saves Rodrigo's life, unaware that he is the son of Esteban, the person responsible for all her problems. Rodrigo falls in love with Luna and decides to change his ways. Meanwhile Rodrigo's cousins Paloma, who has feelings for him and Daniela, ruthless and ambitious, who is Mauricio's lover are having plans for getting their hands on Esteban's entire fortune. But Luna's sudden appearance immediately makes her a threat and foe.

name: Luna salvaje
summary: Gonzalo and Leticia have been married for several years. They are happy, but their marriage is marred by the inability to have children. Leticia has tried all methods to conceive, but all have been in vain. Even a second attempt at artificial insemination ended in failure. In despair, she convinces her husband to use a donor woman to conceive. They find Maria, who at first glance seems to be the ideal candidate for this role...

name: 1000 millones
summary: From one day to another Julián Vargas receives an important news, his biological father, whom he did not know, is dying. The magnate Manuel Prado Calets will leave him a Billion Dolars inheritance that will test the values of this man which only fortune they are his family and his childhood friend Carolina Marín. Julián lives in a humble neighborhood with his adoptive mother, his brothers Diego and Gisella and he works as an employee at the port. His more valued exchequers are his friends of the neighborhood, the football matches, his car "The Torino" and his fleeting romances. Unlike Julián, Carolina is about to finish her carrier and works a very important holding and though she is a simple woman her ambitions always overcame to those of his friend. But they share something more than the old neighborhood, they were part of a former history of sweet teenager love. Many people will try to separate Julián of his fortune. The managers of the holding, Lanari and Pilar Arias and the family Prado Calets will fight up to the end to destroy him. Julián and Carolina will try to overcome the conflicts that they will be provided by this new life riddled with power, interests and enemies. Together they will cross a new way and will discover a great love.

name: Calypso
summary: Two sisters fall in love with the same man - a mysterious castaway, who pretends to suffer from amnesia.

name: María Rosa, búscame una esposa
summary: Of all the tasks given to her by her boss, the most difficult is when he tells her: "Maria Rosa, find me a wife." He is a rather attractive bachelor who has absolutely no time or energy to date. Rafael Vargas decides that it is time to get married before someone around him starts to doubt his sexual orientation. And who better than his excellent secretary to carry out this task and find a suitable candidate?

name: Развлечеба
summary: The main character, Kubokot the Cat, will become a guide to the world of mathematics, Russian language, natural science, history, social science, foreign languages and other subjects.

name: Pound House
summary: Something happens this way comes

name: Llovizna
summary: A girl named Llovizna learns that her mother was murdered by the owner of the steel factory where her grandfather worked, who also died in an accident. She intends to take revenge on the killer, but along the way she falls into her own trap, risking the lives of all the people she loves...

name: Az 1% Klub
summary: In this unique show, 100 contestants compete against each other in a giant studio at the same time, answering questions using a touchscreen tablet. Anyone who answers incorrectly is immediately eliminated. The difficulty level of the questions is determined by how many of the members of a pre-surveyed panel representative of the country's population knew the correct answer. The fewer people who were able to solve the question during the preliminary research, the more difficult the question is in the studio game. In the final, 15th round, the question that only 1% of the participants were able to answer correctly is asked.

name: Подмосковная кадриль
summary: Longtime friends and neighbors Rita and Lena make a bet: the disputed hundred square meters of land between their plots will go to the one who seduces and marries theater and film actor Denis Maksimov. Rita agrees to the adventure only because she does not take him seriously. Lena, on the contrary, dreams of a beautiful life in the capital and has long been dreaming of Maksimov. She manages to move in with Denis and even gain the trust of his mother. But as soon as the actor has problems in his career, Lena loses interest in him. Meanwhile, Rita is seriously determined to help Maksimov get out of a difficult situation...

name: Рыбка золотая
summary: Nadya has been married to Igor for ten years. He has created a successful construction business, and she helps him as a lawyer. A major deal in Nadya's hometown is suspended because one person does not want to sell his land. And so she goes to Rybinsk to solve the problem. Nadya collects information about the stubborn landowner. It turns out that Andrey only owns half of the house, and the other half belongs to his ex-wife. The woman is ready to sell, but Andrey is not. All attempts by the capital's lawyer to persuade Andrey are unsuccessful, so Nadya takes a desperate step: she buys half of his house and begins to poison his life, forcing him to sell. Competing in creating unbearable living conditions for each other, they themselves do not notice how they begin to get closer.

name: 4етыре
summary: A dreamy culinary school graduate, Sashka, comes to conquer Moscow. He dreams of having his own restaurant, but for now he has to work in a third-rate eatery and put up with a rude manager. The guy is even less lucky with his neighbors: the only available option is a workshop in an abandoned factory building, which has been chosen by four strange types: Discord, Death, Plague and Famine. These four horsemen of the apocalypse signed a contract to destroy the Earth, according to which they are supposed to have their most cherished wish fulfilled. But another weighty condition is that they must arrange this apocalypse themselves, and if humanity is destroyed by aliens, artificial intelligence, an ecological disaster or even mutant mushrooms, the horsemen will not receive their reward. So for several centuries now they have had to save humanity from the deadly dangers raining down on it, which the inhabitants of the planet do not even suspect. Sashka amazes the four with his culinary skills, teaches them to watch TV and quickly becomes one of the rescue squad.

name: The Thundermans: Undercover
summary: Phoebe and Max are assigned a mission in their new hi-tech beach home base, where their superhero identities remain a secret. They bring Chloe along to help her have a normal life, but the trio must stop the threats of Secret Shores and the true supervillain known as the Mastermind.

name: Резервация
summary: Former police officer Sergei returns home - but his home is gone. His home district, cut off from the outside world by a mysterious anomaly, is now called a reservation. There is no communication or normal rules in the reservation, and any attempt to leave its borders ends in death. Hoping to uncover the secret of the anomaly and get his family out of the trap, Sergei makes his way into the closed territory. But is it only the anomaly that stands in his way?

name: Баранкины и камни силы
summary: The Barankin family are hereditary drivers in the tenth generation. Every day they drive around Moscow and the Moscow region, deliver clients, and unusual stories happen to them. Superpowers help the Barankins to be everywhere and maintain a high rating in the taxi app. Representatives of this family can transform, stop time and even read minds. One day, Varvara Barankina, a city cab driver who started the Barankin family, is teleported from the past to the streets of modern Moscow. Now the family has to return the girl home and deal with the mysterious villain who has opened a hunt for her.

name: Uncharted: Eye of Indra
summary: A motion comic set before the events of Uncharted: Drake's Fortune. It was released to promote the game Uncharted: Eye of Indra (2009).

name: След-52
summary: special project from the creators of the series Next. This project was created in order to more fully reveal the images of the main characters, i.e. the FES workers. In each episode, we either learn something new from the life of the hero, or observe a crime directly related to one of our favorites, and worry about them.

name: Симон
summary: Simon, a builder, dies in the small mountain town of Byrd. He was known not only as an excellent bricklayer and roofer, but also as an incomparable ladies' man. His four lovers, Sylvia, Eliza, Sofia and Susanna, come to say goodbye to him. Will women be able to posthumously forgive the deceased for his numerous affairs?

name: Echo serca
summary: Psychologist Magdalena Borska returns to Poland after a few years of absence from the country and starts working in a hospital. On the very first day, the doctor has to face not only the patients' problems, but also the reluctance of the entire medical team, especially Andrzej Stommy, the head of surgery. The hospital employees hide from Magda the trauma they experience after a failed rescue operation that took place six months earlier, and one of the best surgeons in the hospital, Jan Sowiński, was accused of malpractice. How will the fate of the heroes go?

previousepisode.name: Future - I've Always Wanted to Be a Family

name: King of Drag
summary: Ten kings. One crown. King of Drag, presented by e.l.f., is the first ever drag KING competition series: where masculinity meets artistry, swagger meets sequins, and drag kings finally take center stage. Hosted by Murray Hill and ruled by the illustrious "Kings' Court" including regular judges Tenderoni, Sasha Velour, Gottmik, and Wang Newton. Each episode features special guest judges, memorable challenges, and a competition like never before.

name: The Bridge
summary: The Bridge sees in-depth discussions between three pairs from Activism, Comedy and Journalism: Model and activism icon, Munroe Bergdorf, chats to Black Lives Matter thought leader, Imarn Ayton; Legendary comedian Stephen K Amos is in conversation with recent TikTok superstar, Ehiz; Long-time journalist and presenter Sean Fletcher sits down with up and coming entertainment journalist, Will Njobvu.

previousepisode.name: Sean Fletcher and Will Njobvu Discuss Their Backgrounds In The Journalism World

name: Secrets of the Comedy Circuit
summary: Secrets of the Comedy Circuit showcases the vibrant Northern Ireland comedy scene, with local talent and other stand-up artists from further afield, as they share their unique observations.

name: Zongmen Li Chule Wo Dou Shi Wodi
Meet Love in Chong Qing
summary: A girl from the north, Tian Ningmeng, faces betrayal by her boyfriend and the collapse of her company. Forced to return to her hometown, Tongnan, a district in Chong Qing, she unexpectedly encounters a boy, Jiao Tang, who generously helps her repay her debts. From then on, the two embark on a hilarious and heartfelt entrepreneurial journey together. Little do they know, fate had already intertwined their lives.

name: Black Warrant
summary: Black Warrant follows a newly appointed jailer, Sunil and his colleagues as they navigate a system that challenges everything they believe. As Sunil grapples with moral dilemmas and power struggles, the drama reveals the raw and unfiltered reality of prison life.

name: Murder Before Evensong
summary:
When Daniel announces a plan to install a lavatory in the church, the parish is suddenly (and unexpectedly) divided: as lines are drawn, long-buried secrets come dangerously close to destroying the apparent calm of the village. And then Anthony Bowness – cousin to Bernard de Floures, patron of Champton – is found dead at the back of the church, stabbed in the neck with a pair of secateurs.

As the police move in and the bodies start piling up, Daniel is the only one who can try and keep his fractured community together… and catch a killer.

name: Valkorey
summary: VALKOREY is an anime-inspired animated web series featuring a mentally unstable & unpredictable protagonist who arises from the dead in search of a mysterious paradise to call her home.

name: America's Team: The Gambler and His Cowboys
summary: Through never-before-seen footage and interviews, this series tells the definitive story of the Dallas Cowboys and Jerry Jones' impact on NFL history.

name: Reality with the King
summary: The brainchild behind OWN's "Love & Marriage" franchise and "Belle Collective" series, renowned executive producer Carlos King takes viewers behind the scenes of all of OWN's hottest shows, spilling tea and diving into all the drama. With candid chats featuring fan-favorite guests, Carlos keeps it real, raw, and always entertaining.

name: Twenty Thousand Streets Under the Sky
summary: A story of unrequited love set in 1930s London, against the backdrop of grimy streets and public houses.

name: An Update on Our Family
summary: An Update on Our Family explores the complex and symbiotic world of family vlogging – a phenomenon in which parents post a steady stream of lifestyle videos on their social media channels to be consumed by loyal subscribers whose views in turn generate money for the vloggers themselves. After controversy around former family vloggers Myka and James Stauffer went public, new scrutiny arose around the industry. The documentary raises questions about what motivates vloggers to expose their lives to the world and examines the issues surrounding making their children's lives public. The three-part series exposes the hidden-in-plain-sight, unregulated family vlogging industry.

name: Beleza Fatal
summary: Two families, two devastating injustices, and one shared plan for revenge. A daughter who loses her mother is unjustly imprisoned and murdered in jail; a mother who loses her daughter is the victim of medical malpractice. Both join forces to take revenge on those who destroyed their families.

name: Sport Stories
summary: Interviews with famous sports stars.

name: The Scandal of Chunhwa
summary:
Set in the fictional country of Dongbangguk. Hwari is youngest princess of the royal family. She grew up with an independent mindset. When she reaches the age to marry, she decides to find her husband by herself. She comes out of the palace to meet her suitors. She also tries to find the person who painted her face as the main female character in a series of erotic chunhwa paintings.

Meanwhile, Choi Hwan is first on the list of potential husbands for Princess Hwari. He is the wealthiest merchant and possesses a handsome appearance. He looks like a man who enjoys women and money, but he seems to hide a secret.

name: Made in Korea
summary: In 1970s South Korea a man determined to reach the pinnacle of wealth and power lives a double life - KCIA agent by day and dangerous business man by night. Determined and unstoppable, he comes face to face with a tenacious prosecutor willing to risk it all to bring him down.

name: Buried Hearts
summary: To survive, a man hacked into a political slush fund worth 2 trillion won. The other man is a powerful shadowy figure, who loses 2 trillion won by killing a man without knowing that he was hacked.

previousepisode.name: You'll Have to Ask More Earnestly

name: Miss Fallaci
summary: Based on the story of Italian journalist and writer Oriana Fallaci. Set in the late 1950s, this season follows the early career of Oriana Fallaci, when she was still known as "the girl from the movies" and worked as a reporter for the Italian weekly magazine L'Europeo. It was during this time that Fallaci turned her first trip to the United States into a unique opportunity, meeting extraordinary figures and painting a sharp, often raw and ironic, portrait of American culture and the reality behind the glamorous façade of Hollywood. These years were also marked by deep personal turmoil, including an intense and troubled relationship with fellow journalist Alfredo Pieroni. This relationship, full of passion but also insecurities and fears, eventually dragged Fallaci into a spiral of self-destruction. Above all, it was a period when a young woman with extraordinary determination and talent discovered her true mission: to tell the truth. And she realized that to do so, all she needed was her most powerful weapon: her voice, unique and distinctive.

name: Summer Pockets
summary: Hairi Takahara, after an unpleasant incident, he uses the recent death of his grandmother as an excuse to come to the island to take care of her estate sale. Once there, he gets to know four girls: Shiroha Naruse, who forgot her summer vacation; Ao Sorakado, who is pursuing the legends of the island; Kamome Kushima, a high-class girl looking for a pirate ship; and Tsumugi Wenders, a younger girl trying to find herself.

name: Low Life
summary: A man and his uncle are offered to find a bowl relic in the West Sea, and they jump into a treasure hunt to escape from their lives of selling fakes. As more and more people search for the treasure, their obsessions become mad and they are forced to make choices between desire and humanity.

name: The Murky Stream
summary: A gripping tale of twisted fates unfolds in lawless Joseon, where the once-pristine Gyeonggang River has turned into a murky stream. Jang Si Yul, a man who buries his past to survive as a gangster, Choi Eun, a sharp-minded and righteous soul, and Jung Chun, an idealist striving to become an honest official, find their destinies entangled in a world where justice is scarce, and survival comes at a cost.

name: Out of the Closet
summary: Breaking outside of the four sugar walls of the Drag Race studio, Out of the Closet takes the cameras into the creative spaces and homes of some of the show's fiercest Queens, giving fans extra insight into their drag style, fashion and more.

previousepisode.name: Sasha Velour: A Winning Closet Reveal

name: RuPaul's Drag Race: Portrait of a Queen
summary: A documentary series revealing the lives, careers, and journeys of some of the most iconic queens from RuPaul's Drag Race.

name: Дорогой родственник
summary: The Gromov family - grandmother Vera Egorovna, her daughters Ira and Liza and pregnant granddaughter Olya with her henpecked husband Tolik - have lived all their lives in the center of St. Petersburg in a large communal apartment. Finally, they decide to leave and spend their shares of the apartment in their own way. But when collecting documents, it turns out that Dima, Ira's ex-husband and Olya's father, an alcoholic and manipulator who left the family a long time ago, is still registered in the apartment. Dima's long search leads nowhere, and suddenly he himself appears on the threshold of the communal apartment. The Gromovs will not only have to say goodbye to their plans, but also live together with Dima, who every day he goes on drunken sprees and behaves antisocially. It is impossible to get rid of him in an amicable way, and out of despair the women decide that Dima must be killed.

name: James Corden's World Cup Live
summary: James Corden's World Cup Live was a comedy chat show hosted by comedian James Corden during the 2010 FIFA World Cup. The show was broadcast after every ITV evening match with Abbey Clancy, celebrity guests, a football hero, a studio full of fans, Corden's friends and family, his human World Cup wall chart, and challenges for his celebrity guests, such as 'How Many Peter Jones?', 'Heston Blumen-Cool or Heston Blumem-Fool?' or 'Uru-Guy or Uru-Girl?' and 'Joachim Löw or Joachim No?' . The programme also featured exclusive interviews with some of the biggest names in English football, plus regular updates of what was happening in the England players' camp.

previousepisode.name: Andrew Flintoff, John Bishop, Dynamo, Peter Crouch, Lemar, Richard Bacon, Tinchy Stryder

name: Le JAP, juge d'application des peines
MasterChef Confeitaria
summary: Ana Paula Padrão presents the biggest cooking reality show in the world, which reveals the best professional confectioners in Brazil.

name: Yellowstone Wolves: Succession
summary: Yellowstone is the ultimate stage for epic wolf dramas-- pack bonds, rivalries, invasions, exiles, and killings. It's also the best place to study wild wolf behavior, because you can get close enough to see the wolves as unique individuals. Follow the succession saga of these amazing wolves-- the leading ladies, the schoolyard bullies, the wily elders, the rare snow queens-- and the equally remarkable people who are devoted to them.

name: The Pier
summary:
The Pier follows the highs and lows of life on Llandudno Pier during the summer of 2021 as life begins again in this Victorian seaside gem.

In this series we share Adam's love affair with this Victorian masterpiece and meet the men and women who keep so many of our seaside traditions alive - the stall keepers, food vendors, entertainers, boatmen and hoteliers who combine to make a day at the Welsh seaside such a magical and unforgettable experience.

name: Narco Circus
summary: In January 2016, El Chapo, a major Mexican drug trafficker, was arrested. He was extradited and then tried in 2019 in the United States in a trial that was intended to be exemplary.

name: The Weekend Travel Show
summary: Kym Marsh and Richard Arnold take us on a joyful romp of a travel series that explores exciting destinations through vibrant VT packages featuring famous faces. They share their own adventures and insights, alongside travel experts who provide handy tips and tricks to enhance your journeys. Plus, resident travel guru Simon Calder answers viewer questions.

name: A Royal Residence
summary: A look behind the scenes at various royal residences.

name: Justice is Mine
summary: Qin Yu, who used to be an upright judge, covered up the truth that his son caused an accident and injured the son of a gang leader in a traffic collision. To avenge his son, the gang leader tirred up a storm of bloodshed. Tang Xuan, a policewoman, stuck to justice and pursued the truth relentlessly.

name: Kate
summary: She's the princess that's captured the hearts of a nation. But how much do you really know about Kate Middleton? Kate is a gripping documentary that shows our future Queen as you've never seen her before. With first hand testimony from those who know her best, this intimate personal portrait reveals how Princess Kate has become the bedrock of the monarchy, and the future of the royal family. We follow the remarkable story of her rise from girl next door to Princess of Wales...and one day, the future Queen of the United Kingdom. With never-before-seen access to those in her inner circle, this series gets up close and personal to provide a definitive account and unique insight into the real Kate, and how she has triumphed over adversity to become a beloved Princess of the people.

name: Britain's Great Cathedrals: To the Glory of God
summary:
In this fascinating two-part series Reverend Pat Allerton embarks on a personal pilgrimage to unlock the secrets of Britain's most spectacular cathedrals, uncovering amazing events witnessed across the 
centuries, as well as the inspiring stories of how they were built.

name: Queens of Music
summary: Stories of Black women working in the music industry from the 1980s to present.

name: Маски
summary: Seven years ago, Olga's older sister Vika disappeared. The last girl to be seen was her friends, with whom they were vacationing together in a country boarding house. Among them was Mikhail, now he is Olga's husband and considers it his duty to carefully protect her from traumatic memories of her sister. But suddenly all participants in that fateful meeting receive an invitation to gather again outside the city. Now they will not be able to hide from the past and hide the truth - everyone is under suspicion.

name: 7/7: The London Bombings
summary: 7 July 2005: four bombs explode in London - the first suicide bombings on English soil. Hour by hour, day by day, the story of the biggest police investigation in British history.

name: Joanna Page's Wild Life
summary: Joanna Page follows her lifelong dream to become a wildlife rescue volunteer. Among the adorable animals, can she master the three Rs - rescue, rehab and release?

name: Harikatha
summary: In a village, Arjun, a young man of that village as the president of the village panchayat makes the village a model village by providing all kinds of facilities and rectifying people's problems. He earns a lot of love and the whole village follows him.

previousepisode.name: Tragédies ou l'illusion de la mort

name: When It Rains, It Pours
summary: Kazuaki is troubled by the lack of intimacy with his live-in lover. Meanwhile, Sei, his childhood friend and co-worker who lives with him, harbors unrequited feelings for Kazuaki. One day, Kazuaki's email is mistakenly delivered to Sei, and they continue to have a strange relationship where they confide their worries to each other by email, without knowing each other's true identities. This is the ultimate love story of two people at the mercy of unrequited love and sex.

name: Call Me By No Name
summary: Megumi Yotsugi, a student at Eichi University, encounters a beautiful woman, Kotoha Furuhashi, who has been abandoned in a garbage dump. After inviting Kotoha to her home, Megumi hopes to become friends with her. However, Kotoha proposes an unusual arrangement: they will act as "lovers" until Megumi can guess her real name. The two make a peculiar bet—if Megumi succeeds in guessing Kotoha's name during their temporary relationship, they will become friends as originally intended. Unable to back out, Megumi grows closer to Kotoha as they play the roles of lovers. However, the hidden past tied to Kotoha's name begins to surface, threatening their bond.

name: Moi... et l'autre
summary: Denise Létourneau and Dominique André, two roommates and two very good friends, live in an apartment building in Montreal, Canada. They live crazy adventures, often initiated by Denise.

previousepisode.name: Dodo et Denise Racontent leur Vie

name: The Promise of the Soul
summary:
When 69-year-old Cha Hsia's grandson announces his intention to undergo a sex change, Cha Hsia accidentally falls down the stairs with him, and his soul then enters the youthful body of his grandson. From that day on, he experiences many firsts in his grandson's body: going to college, living in a dormitory, being kissed by a man, and falling in love.
Does the classmate the grandson secretly admires actually like him back? In the dormitory, his grandson's boyfriend even takes off his pants and wants to… Who is the red thread of fate connected to?

name: LOL Talent Show: Chi fa ridere è dentro
summary: Straight from the world of LOL comes LOL Talent Show: Chi fa ridere è dentro! Get ready for a barrage of aspiring comedians and an exciting contest hosted by Forest, the magician! Three judges: Elio, Katia Follesa, and Angelo Pintus. Their mission? To find the tenth contestant for LOL 4! They'll travel through Italy and be assisted by a different guest judge on every episode.

name: The Basement Talks
summary: A man carrying a black duffel bag entered a clinic. By the day's end, two women were dead, and a search for the culprit was afoot.

name: Marconi - L'uomo che ha connesso il mondo
Evolve and Flex with Lance Fresh
summary: Evolve and Flex with sports-lifestyle host and style guru Lance Fresh is a series that dives deep into personal fashion journeys, uncovering how life experiences have shaped and transformed each guest's style evolution. The show highlights pivotal moments and influences that have impacted their fashion choices, offering a fresh perspective on how life and fashion intersect -- while also showcasing the powerful connection between sports and style.

name: L'Armée des Romantiques
summary: A young generation of artists inspired by their English and German neighbors is determined to revolutionize art: Victor Hugo, George Sand, Honoré de Balzac, Alexandre Dumas, Eugène Delacroix, Gérard de Nerval, Charles Baudelaire ... While the people in the streets rumble and clamor for the Republic, the Romantics will not rest until freedom is in power. Their works and ideas will fundamentally transform French society.

name: The Haunted Palace
summary: Born with shamanic powers that she refuses to accept, a young woman confronts her gift to rid the Joseon palace of evil spirits and save her first love.

name: The Art of Negotiation
summary: Yoon Joo-no, a key figure in the former M&A Team of SANIN GROUP, suddenly disappeared one day, leaving for Hawaii for undisclosed reasons. Rumors spread that he had been demoted, but the truth remains unknown to anyone. Then, three years later, when SANIN GROUP is facing bankruptcy with 11 billion dollars in debt, he is called back to Korea as their last hope. His mission is clear: to save SANIN GROUP. However, his solution is far from straightforward. Gaining the support of CEO Song Jae-sik, he forms a new M&A Team and gathers the best negotiators to dive into the perilous world of high-stakes deals. With his team, Joo-no takes one last gamble. Can he secure the 11 billion dollars needed to save the company, or will even the so-called "god of negotiation" be brought down?

name: Knock Off
summary:
Kim Seong-Jun (Kim Soo-Hyun) is regular office worker, but, after the IMF crisis, he lost his job and began working the counterfeit market. He begins to work as the vice chairman of a counterfeit producing company and grows the company into one of the largest counterfeiters in the world. He relies on his intelligence, quick response to unexpected situations, and a strong desire for success to become the king of the counterfeit market.

Meanwhile, Song Hye-Jeong (Jo Bo-Ah) is Kim Seong-Jun's ex-girlfriend and she works as a special judicial police officer, whose job is to crack down on counterfeit goods. Kim Seong-Jun and Song Hye-Jeong form a tense relationship surrounding the crackdown of counterfeit goods.

name: Walking on Thin Ice
summary: A human thriller that takes place when a housewife in her 40s with a sick husband accidentally picks up drugs that fell on the road.

name: Queen Mantis
summary: A thriller that follows a woman who was imprisoned as a serial killer a long time ago, and someone begins a serial killing imitating her.

name: Inside the Enchanted Forests
summary: Traverse the planet's richest, most diverse woodlands, from the tropics to the poles and everywhere in between. Get to know the wild residents of these magical ecosystems and learn how forests connect and nurture the lives of countless species.

name: Rivages
summary: Following the inexplicable sinking of a trawler and its fishermen who remain untraceable, Abigail, an oceanographer, is sent by IFREMER on a mission to Fécamp, her hometown, which she left a few years earlier following a family tragedy. As her research progresses, new mysterious phenomena occur at sea, making the activity of fishermen, although essential to local life, impossible. Abigail will learn that these disasters could originate from an underwater presence capable of upsetting the fragile balance between man and nature... What if the cause of the disturbances does not correspond to anything known?

name: Santuario
summary: After the climate disaster, women spend their pregnancy in the Sanctuary, a dome with improved climate conditions. There they live in peace, cared for and relaxed, away from their families and the rest of society to prevent the polluted air from affecting the pregnancy.

name: Docteur Godard - l'homme qui voulait tout quitter
summary: This four-part documentary series, adapted from Eric Lemasson's book, explores one of the biggest criminal mysteries of the last twenty years, following the trail of the missing family, from Normandy to the north of Scotland, via Saint-Malo and the Isle of Man. The investigation links this family drama to the assassination, in 2001, of the emblematic leader of a small traders' union, the CDCA, by professional killers. The tragic story of the doctor who decided to drop everything to change his life intersects with the mafia nebula surrounding this "anti-system" union.

name: Who is a Wolf?
summary: Men and women who gathered to get the best love. However, among the members, one or more "liar" wolves who do not fall in love are lurking in either the man or the woman.

name: Saving Grace
summary: Anna, an elementary school teacher, discovers that her student Grace is a victim of abuse. Driven by maternal instinct, Anna abducts Grace to protect her and assumes the role of a mother. As they bond amid threats from the authorities and Grace's abusive mother, Anna confronts her painful past, realizing that she needs healing as much as Grace does.

name: True Love Moon
summary: It tells the story of a prince stationed at the frontier, who received a secret order from the crown prince and rushed to Yuncheng with his cavalry. However, he was ambushed by the secret guards as soon as he arrived at the gate, and was inexplicably accused of treason. After a fierce fight, he finally escaped, but he was turned into a child. As a child with a body of only 10 years old, how can he solve the mystery step by step, and how can he survive the pursuit?

name: Love Rewritten
summary: An assassination attempt triggers a soul-swap between divorcing couple Xiao Jingyang and Lin Mingxuan - sending them back to pre-wedding days! While cooperating to reverse the swap, their unresolved tensions flare. Just as their bodies return and truths emerge, Xiao pushes Lin away… only for her to uncover his secret. Now, with hidden forces stirring and death looming, Lin vows to stand by Xiao against all odds.

name: Cosme & Damião: Quase Santos
summary: Cosme and Damião earn their living selling candy on the street – it is the megalomania of the first combined with the innocence of the second that will lead them to the biggest robberies in Realengo.

name: Gassal
summary: Gassal tells the story of a gassal who pursues the question "Who will wash me when I die?" and tells the story of Baki, who decides to reshape his life after coming face to face with death. Living side by side with death as a gassal, Baki discovers new meanings about life while looking for someone to wash him. The series invites the audience to both think and understand the value of life, while also offering an enjoyable experience with humorous elements here and there.

previousepisode.name: Ölüm, Dilime Dolanan Bir Şarkı Gibi...

name: Социальная защита
summary:
The life of successful lawyer and law school professor Marta Orlova changes dramatically in just one day. She discovers that her fiancé and colleague, Artem, is cheating on her, and her stepfather, the head of Marta's firm who raised her after her mother's death, sides with Artem, claiming Marta's marriage to the son of General Nikolsky is beneficial to both families.

Finding herself without support or the ability to continue working with her stepfather and Artem, Marta decides to open her own law firm, focusing on helping people who are unable to afford legal services.

name: Arman ja 7 kuolemansyntiä
summary: Arman Alizad's documentary series takes viewers to the edge of the world and explores what humanity is doing right and what is wrong. Human influence on the world has expanded so widely with the development of technology and science that in 2008, Vatican Archbishop Gianfranco Girrotti named the new deadly sins of the modern world. Inspired by these, Arman Alizad has examined the injustices that prevail in our world and wonders if they are really sins.

name: Woeste Grond
summary: Three generations of the Ottink family work together on one farm. Each has a different vision for the future of their beloved dairy farm. Woeste Grond shows the emotional and recognizable dynamics of a farming family balancing tradition and modernity.

name: Can Borcu
summary: After his wife's death, Mehmet, a successful lawyer, begins to face challenges with his daughter, Doğa. Holding her father responsible for her mother's death, Doğa, fueled by the turbulence of adolescence, subjects him to intense emotional strain. The tension between them peaks when Doğa attempts suicide. Meanwhile, the seemingly perfect marriage of Handan and Celal suffers a major blow on their 25th wedding anniversary. A seed of doubt is planted in Handan's mind, making her suspect that her husband might be unfaithful. Despite her attempts to dismiss this suspicion, a phone call confirming her fears marks the beginning of the end for her. Mehmet, desperate to save his daughter from her suicidal path, and Handan, heading to confront her husband at a hotel, cross paths in a cruel twist of fate.

name: Longitude
summary: Longitude is an extraordinary true story of adventure, intrigue and power on the high seas of 18th century England.

name: Knockout
summary: Knockout will take an unflinching look at the life of legendary boxer and cultural icon Mike Tyson. Known as the youngest heavyweight champion in history (at the age of 20 in 1986), Tyson's legacy extends far beyond the ropes of the boxing ring, cementing him as one of the most compelling and polarizing figures of our time. From his meteoric rise as the "Baddest Man on the Planet" to his personal struggles – including a period of incarceration and widely publicized struggles (i.e. finances, substance abuse, in-ring controversies) – and eventual redemption, this series will explore the man behind the gloves.

name: Les Carnets de Julie
summary: Julie Andrieu travels across various regions in France and explores their landscape, culture and culinary heritage.

previousepisode.name: À la table de Georges Simenon

name: Great Migrations: A People on the Move
summary:
Great Migrations: A People on the Move tells the story of African American movement over the 20th and 21st centuries, and how it has shaped our nation by exploring the meaning behind those movements. What political or economic pressures inspire people to move? Is it more often inspired by hope or fear? Is there even such a thing as a promised land? 

Human beings have always moved en masse. Since the beginning of human existence, movement has defined how we evolved and created identities, communities, and nations-states. Migration is not unique to any single ethnicity or group, but it is a deeply profound aspect of the modern African American experience simply because Black people were denied movement for so long. Theirs was a forced migration from Africa, followed by centuries of enslavement that kept them in place. In being denied movement, they were denied their humanity. 

After emancipation, the migratory spirit took hold in this new space of freedom, and many African Americans uprooted themselves from all that was familiar to move to northern cities (sometimes stopping first in southern cities) to build entirely new lives – a decision that dramatically changed the fabric of American culture and society. It was an epic migration of people that began in the late 19th century when it was clear that the early promises of Reconstruction would not be fulfilled, and accelerated as the century progressed. Underlying this courageous act was the abiding belief in American opportunity, as well as a belief in their own capacity to better their lives, and the lives of their children. In some ways, it has never really ended.

name: The Pet Rescuers
summary: The Pet Rescuers follows the work of a team on a mission to give abandoned pets a second chance.

name: Oceanfront Property Hunt
summary:
Prospective buyers look to make their dream of living by the ocean a reality as they hunt for oceanfront properties along the Atlantic coastline.

Who doesn't dream of living by the ocean? Oceanfront Property Hunt follows prospective buyers looking to purchase their first oceanfront home. Our buyers are families from all walks of life. In some episodes, we'll meet people looking for a unique fixer-upper. Or we'll follow their search for a modest family home. Other folks want a spacious, turn-key dream home along the rugged coastline.

name: I, Caesar
summary: Tracing the rise and fall of the Roman Empire over 500 years through the public and private lives of six of the Empire's rulers.

previousepisode.name: Justinian - The Last of the Romans

name: Celebrity MasterChef
summary: Witness cooking like never before as celebrities take over the kitchen station with hosts Farah Khan, Ranveer Brar and Vikas Khanna.

name: Naka De Salon
summary: On Laem Sing Beach in the Buddhist era 2540 (1997), on a day when the grey sky portended a coming storm, Kamol gave birth to Suricha in the middle of a fishing boat. In the depths below them was the shadow of a great serpent waiting to give its blessing. Kamol did not survive, however, and Suricha was raised by a single father. Fifteen years later, out of nowhere, Suricha loses another important figure in her life to suicide. There was only a tuft of fiery red hair by her father's body. In Chanthaburi 2565 (2022), twenty-five-year-old Suricha is a beautician with particular skills. When she touches someone's hair, she sees numbers related to their fate. When that skill gives her the knowledge to help the salon of a famous makeup artist out of its plight, she gains the disfavour of the manager Yukha.

name: Double Jeu
summary: When Sergeant Rousseau loses another double agent to organized crime, she has no choice but to try a new approach. Rather than hiring recruits, she turns to Adam and Mounir, two Maghrebian actors who will become double agents for a top-secret police division where, thanks to their acting talent.

name: Koek
summary: When Cape Town housewife Christelle Smit discovers evidence her husband is having an affair with a stripper named Candy Floss, her investigation takes her to a world poles apart from the suburban utopia she knows.

name: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes
summary:
Living in a superhuman society, it is hard to feel special. Even more so when the spotlight only shines on professional heroes, those legally authorized to use their special powers known as Quirks in public for the greater good.

Kouichi Haimawari grew up aspiring to be a hero, but with a mediocre Quirk like "sliding" that ties him to the ground, he soon came to the conclusion that he could only ever admire them from below. Despite this, Kouichi finds contentment in using his Quirk to carry out day-to-day good deeds, such as returning lost items and helping the elderly cross the street.

However, Kouichi's tame life takes a swing into the turbulent when he is rescued from a back alley brawl by Vigilante, or illegal hero, Knuckleduster. Seeing hero potential in Kouichi, Knuckleduster enlists his help in tracking down the source of a dangerous drug known as Trigger that boosts the user's Quirk at the expense of their rationality.

Set in a time before the events of the original story, Vigilante: Boku no Hero Academia Illegals follows Kouichi as he chooses to don the reputation of a villain and become a Vigilante, operating in the shadow of the law to prevent crimes from taking to the surface.

name: May Your Heart Be Like Mine
Paradise Hotel
summary: Valerio Zeno receives a group of singles at Paradise Hotel, where one hotel rule applies: either you share a room or you check out. At check-in, the participants indicated whether they came for money or love. Blooming loves, broken hearts and new friendships that are put to the test: who can withstand that and knows how to hold out until the end?

previousepisode.name: Als Ik Deze Check-Out Had Gehaald, Was Ik De Winnaar

name: Putain
summary: When Brussels resident Gigi discovers that his mother Anaïs is dating her ex Fabrice again, with whom she shared a drug addiction in the past, in addition to love, he gives her an ultimatum: her son or her lover.

name: The Gruffalo
summary: Animation based on the classic children's picture book written by Julia Donaldson and illustrated by Axel Scheffler, telling the magical tale of a mouse who takes a walk through the woods in search of a nut.

name: Homestead: The Series
summary: A continuation of the movie Homestead... Amid chaos, ex-Green Beret joins prepper compound; love grows, truths arise, and a community unites.

previousepisode.name: "Maybe that's what it took. Maybe it was worth it."

name: Burning Passion
summary: Years ago, Shen Qingru's mother was drowned for adultery by the clan leader. Branded as the daughter of a "fallen woman," Qingru grew up numb and tormented under the town's scorn, carrying the weight of her mother's tragic fate. Then came Shen Cheng—the "mute" boy who became both her salvation and her greatest weakness. Their bond blurred the fragile line of "siblings," yet the world's gaze kept it firmly in place. Under watchful eyes, Qingru swore with tears that she would never fall in love. Forced into marriage to bring luck to the ailing Mo family heir, Qingru was left widowed the night before the wedding. The Mo matriarch demanded she be buried with him. Meanwhile, Shen Cheng was lured into a deadly trap. To save him, Qingru married the seemingly "gentle" son of the clan leader. Left for dead in a mass grave, Shen Cheng miraculously survived. Years later, the once "mute and rugged" young man returned as a cold and powerful marshal, hiding his true identity as he stepped back into the town—only for her.

name: The Gold Behind the Stone
summary: Wei Jianhao, a young man with the unique identify stone ability "Jade Buddha Hand," returns to Chongjiang and is forced into the conflict between the Tang and Gu families, constantly facing challenges from skilled opponents. Unable to stand idly by as the Jade Street faces danger, he uses his extraordinary abilities to navigate the treacherous situation, transitioning from wanting to escape to fully protecting it, fighting for justice in a world full of twists and turns.

name: Чемпионы
summary: Archrivals from the Multi-Sport School League compete for the title of champion in a variety of disciplines

name: Hide Games
summary: Set in an alternate reality, Hide Games unravels around a mystery case—the murder of a narcotics officer. Packed with nonstop thrills, the series delves deep into the clash between good and evil. Beyond the excitement of piecing together every clue, it explores the complexity of human nature as shocking truths gradually come to light.

name: Lives Well Lived
summary: Reflecting the extraordinary lives of some of the famous faces and notable figures who we lost in the last year. Friends, fans and family share their treasured memories.

name: The Bozo Show
summary: The Bozo Show was the longest running show on WGN-TV Chicago. It featured the cast of the original shows with sketches, cartoons (such as Rocky and Bullwinkle), a miniture game show called "Bozo's Grand Prize Game", and fun stuffs. In 1995, The show was relegated to weekends only and the show renamed as "The Bozo Super Weekend Show".

name: A megőrzött vadon
summary: The documentary presents Hungary's special and unique natural phenomena, living creatures and plants in the areas where everything is done to preserve the original wilderness.

name: Мама, мы – ЦСКА!
summary:
After triumphing in the Russian Cup, head coach Marko Nikolić unexpectedly leaves the club, and CSKA Moscow appoints swiss coach Fabio Celestini as his successor. Within just a few months, he transforms the team and restores its belief in winning the league title. For the first time in ten years, CSKA are once again among the main contenders for the championship.

But real football begins where the broadcast ends. The cameras go behind the scenes, into the dressing room, the training ground and the players' homes. Viewers will discover why Nikolić left the club and learn how the careers of legendary CSKA captain Igor Akinfeev, young talents Matvey Kislyak and Kirill Glebov, and many other players on the team unfolded.

name: A Taiwanese Tale of Two Cities
summary: A Taipei doctor and a San Francisco engineer swap homes in a daring pact, embarking on journeys filled with trials, secrets and unexpected encounters.

name: Criminal Scene
summary: Detective Captain Gu Zhen leads his team in investigating a series of crimes, solving complex cases with his sharp instincts and intelligence. Meanwhile, he discovers that he has become the target of revenge orchestrated by the family of a past victim. To protect the people and his loved ones, Gu Zhen confronts a vengeful adversary who has embraced darkness. In the end, justice prevails, and the criminals receive the punishment they deserve.

name: Sophie Ellis-Bextor's New Year's Eve Disco
summary: Put on your sparkliest outfit! Sophie Ellis-Bextor hosts an unforgettable night of disco bliss, with classic dance floor anthems and very special guests to keep the party going.

name: Game of Love
summary: Phlapphla, who works as a writer, has to look after her brother Tong on her own and without the help of Treepradub, their eldest sister who married a wealthy man and never gave her a hand. One day, Tong has an argument with Pheem's brother who is later knocked unconscious by Tong. This causes Phlapphla and Pheem to meet, and their first meeting is disastrous as she slaps him across his face. However, Phlapphla is at a disadvantage due to his sister's assault case, so Pheem gives an offer to become his woman in order to save her sibling.

name: Flying MOCO - House Has a Short-Leg
City of Romance
summary: Bai Xiao Duo, who is used to protecting herself with lies because of her low self-esteem, meets Su Yan Cheng, a genius cartoonist who is very disgusted with lies in the college community. Such different people healed each other in a series of events and gradually healed each other's inner wounds.

name: Studna
summary: The six-part drama directed by Tereza Kopáčová based on a script by Miro Šifra and Kristina Májová returns to a love story that traumatized several generations of Czechoslovaks. What preceded the infamous family tragedy of 1968? What followed it? Where can disrupted relationships in a closed rural community lead? What do we take with us as an inner legacy from our parents?

name: Egypt Detectives
summary: Archaeologist Miriam Cooke and Egyptologist Dominic Montserrat attempt to unravel some of the most intriguing mysteries which the ancient Egyptian race have left behind.

previousepisode.name: The Mystery Of The Animal Mummies

name: Got to Get Out
summary:
Twenty people under one roof, $1 million dollars in prizes up for grabs. To win it, they've GOT TO GET OUT…but that's much easier said than done.

Lies and lunacy collide in this exhilarating competition series where an outrageous mix of reality icons and crafty gamers must conspire to get out. In this house, time is money. As the clock ticks up, so does the prize money. The longer they stay, the greater their chance to earn more. They can split the money equally in the end, or at any point in time, try to make their escape with the accumulated money all for themselves, leaving others to start again at $0. 

From wild strategies and temptations to shifting alliances and unbelievable escape attempts, the players will try any and every way to make it out of the gate and win the prize.

name: Cao Xuanxuan's Love Journey
summary: The story unfolds as Zhou Na, a modern-day mystery novelist, finds herself serendipitously transported to ancient Yan City, where she becomes the fiancée of County Magistrate Guo Zijie. Together, they repeatedly solve bizarre cases. As their mutual affection deepens and their bond grows stronger, a sinister conspiracy involving life and death silently emerges...

name: Cosmosis: UFOs & A New Reality
summary: As people and governments around the world come to terms with the reality of the UFO phenomenon, top experts in science, philosophy, religious studies, and more are grappling with its implications for humanity. Cosmosis: UFOs & A New Reality explores how these revelations challenge our understanding of history, non-human intelligence, and the future. Through interviews with leading researchers and experiencers, this docuseries uncovers the latest evidence and theories, offering a fresh perspective on how these discoveries could reshape society and our place in the cosmos.

name: A Cheetah's Pride
summary: A Cheetah's Pride follows a pair of warring cheetahs as they fight for possession of their cubs.

name: BanG Dream! Ave Mujica
summary:
"Will you give me the rest of your life?"

After losing everything in a single night, Sakiko Togawa reaches out toward an even deeper abyss, one that will drag everyone around her down as well. Gathering the lives of girls burdened with their own troubles and desires, Sakiko raises the curtain on a perfect masquerade.

"Welcome to the world of Ave Mujica."

On a stage where sorrow, death, fear, love—even the solace of forgetting—are stripped away, will their masks be torn off and shatter into oblivion, or will they….

name: Пять шагов по облакам
summary: When publisher and editor-in-chief Valeria Krylova beat out her rival, media magnate Akhmet Bashirov, at the awards ceremony for the best journalists of the year, she had no idea how closely their fates would bind them together. The next day, banker Sadovnikov will be killed under strange circumstances, and both heroes will fall under suspicion of committing the crime: each, according to the investigation, will have compelling motives. Moreover, everything points to the fact that the contract killer was Vasily, a friend of Valeria's close friend, writer Melissa Sinitskaya. And while Melissa and Vasily are hiding in a country house, Valeria is kidnapped. Bashirov's security guard tries to figure out the crime.

name: ФЕЙК
summary: This is a story about a simple student named Lech. He falls in love with the daughter of the most influential businessman in the city and, having disrupted her birthday, gets a round sum. To try to get the money back, Lech gathers a team of friends and decides to sell fake clothes. Whether it will be possible to repay the debt or the thirst for profit will put the lives of people close to Lech on the line, we will find out very soon.

name: Iqtidar
summary: After her brother's murder, Mehrunisa seeks justice against influential figures trying to cover up the truth, facing deceit and corruption along the way.

name: Força-Tarefa
summary: The hidden side of justice. The day-to-day operations of the law enforcement agency that investigates crimes committed by the police itself.

name: Unwind with ITV
summary: A daily delivery of bespoke Mindfulness content designed to calm the mind and encourage relaxation and reflection.

name: Pro Moves
summary: Pro Moves is a brand-new series from First We Feast, where food TV icon Adam Richman shares the tips, tricks, and insider information needed to get the most out of any eating experience. From how to spot the freshest pie at the pizzeria, to the best way to navigate the complexities of a steakhouse menu, Adam has you covered so you can act like the ultimate regular. Over the course of his storied career, Adam has amassed a wealth of culinary knowledge that he's eager to share. But he's also enlisting a few expert guests and celebrity pals—folks Frank Pinello, Scott Wiener, and Emmy Award-winning steakhouse aficionado Bryan Cranston—to help him along the way.

previousepisode.name: Bryan Cranston and Adam Richman Break Down the Steakhouse Commandments

name: Морские дьяволы. Полярный конвой
summary: An international conspiracy is brewing by a number of countries that want to discredit Russia, accuse it of environmental crimes in the polar zone, such as testing chemical and other weapons, and deprive it of access to the Arctic. For this purpose, a daring series of sabotage is planned: the seizure of a nuclear icebreaker, the undermining of the ice floe on which the Russian scientific station North Pole operates, the mining and capture by sabotage divers of a secret underwater facility, an attack on ice-class tankers and much more.

name: Giant Constructions
summary: The documentary series takes an unusual look at the most breathtaking bridge structures man has built. It shows the almost super human effort it takes to design and build these giants. The series goes behind the scenes and shows how much effort the unique structures require to function smoothly every day.

name: Sorairo Utility
summary: Follow high school girl Minami, who is a beginner at golf, and her friends Haruka and Ayaka.

name: Moonwalk
summary: Moonwalk follows two thieves, Tarik Pandey and Maddy Kapoor, as they go head-to-head to steal the heart of a local heartthrob, Chandini Lakhani. Their rivalry and competition lead to dangerous yet hilarious consequences and something far more valuable...and out of this world- a piece of rock from the Moon that lands on Earth!

name: Doctors
summary: Doctors is set at the high-stakes Elizabeth Blackwell Medical Centre in Mumbai, where Dr. Nitya Vasu begins her surgical residency with a personal vendetta against Dr. Ishaan Ahuja, believing he is responsible for her brother's disability. However, as she works alongside him, Nitya realizes Ishaan is not the villain she thought, and her animosity turns to attraction. The series explores intense medical cases and the personal struggles of residents, including ambition, love, and betrayal. The season culminates in shifting relationships, with old enemies becoming allies, a tragic event reshaping the group, and Nitya and Ishaan's love emerging at great personal cost.

name: To Catch a Smuggler: South Pacific
summary: Customs officers fight against drug smuggling at airports, air cargo inspection facilities and the international mail center.
